title: Paper route, a grocery job and school troubles
summary: He delivered the club entertainment papers, tried again in his grandpa's clothes, and worked briefly in a grocery store.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: So I got me a job sellin' papers. I used to go...got me a little paper route, and on the evenings they had them little...on weekends, they had them little [envelope ??] papers, you know, they'd put around in different places, where it was goin' on, all the entertainers and who sang there and all that stuff, so I got a job deliverin' them so that got me back in the nightclubs, so I would...when I bring 'em they papers and stuff, I look the joint over and see what I could see...see what's goin' on. 'Course it be in the daytime. Wasn't nothin' happenin' too much in the daytime. Few stragglers sittin' around the bar, drinkin' beer.

So, I kept on that for a good while, and then I picked up on...well, I said, "Now, this close as I'm ever gonna get. If I wanna be anybody, I better get...I gotta get in here in the nighttime." So I went and jumped into my grandpa's clothes again. Tried it again. So my momma didn't know where I was at, so it be about nine or ten o'clock, and I would go and get a...get one of those...my little sticks that I had...I broke out a chair...told the man, "Let me play the drums. I'm a pretty good drummer." "You cain't play on my drums. You break 'em."

So I a real nuisance. So I went back after that, tried to get help on my schoolin'. Never was too good on goin' to school. I was a slow learner. My sister 'n' them...my sister was smart. She was way ahead of me 'cause she is four years older than me. She was so smart, and everybody thought I should keep up with her. I never did catch her in school. So when she wind up getting married, that was a horse of another color.

But, so then I started to workin' in a grocery store. I was a helpin' put up stuff in the store, and then I learnt with the stamp, a puttin' the prices on the stuff. So that did...that didn't last too long. It wasn't exciting enough. So I went right straight back to doing
what I was doing before...back, tryin' to get into nightclubs.
